'''Dooku's hangar''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in the [[N'ge'u Valley]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] used by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The hangar was located forty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[Geonosian War Room/Legends|war room]] used during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="GORW" /> It was abandoned by Dooku after the battle.

==Description==
The hangar was part of a much larger facility. The facility was a factory that was used to produce aquatic weapons. The production facility ran further down the structure, but the hangar sat higher up in a tower above and was used to house [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian fighters]]. It had one launch chute on the east side of the building, and two entrances. One entrance was to the north and crossed over a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] storage chamber. The east entrance was situated beside the launch chute.

The interior was lined with mosaic tiling that resembled Geonosian egg-nests. The hangar itself was a large cavern-like structure with several gas-release structures sprouting from the ground. The adjacent room held the fuel storage. Above the hangar level was a small maintenance room used by fighters and had five entrances leading from the room and out of the tower.

==History==
[[File:ITW2_Dooku_Hangar.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] hangar cutaway.]]
Originally the hangar was used as a security hangar for Geonosian fighters. It sat at the peak of a tower above a factory that was used to manufacture aquatic sonic weapons for both sides of a short civil war on the swamp world of [[Derenzil/Legends|Derenzil]]. Once the project was over, the facility was abandoned.

Shortly before the start of the Clone Wars, the hangar was used to hold Count Dooku's [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sailer]]. During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], Dooku escaped the mayhem and journeyed to his hidden hangar on a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]. Unfortunately for Dooku, he was spotted by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunship]]. They followed Dooku through the [[E'Y-Akh Desert/Legends|E'Y-Akh Desert]] to the hangar. While Dooku entered through the east entrance, they entered the hangar from the north entrance. Confronting the Count, they engaged Dooku in a duel, though Dooku quickly defeated both Jedi.

However, Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] had sensed the disturbance in the Force caused by their duel and arrived. The two engaged in a battle of Force powers before resorting to a lightsaber duel. Dooku, unable to hold his own against Yoda for much longer, engaged in a ploy to escape, using the Force to knock over a gas-release trunk onto Obi-Wan and Anakin, distracting Yoda. While Yoda used the Force to save the two, Dooku boarded his ship and took off.

After the planetary battle ended, [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agents investigated the hangar to find clues to Dooku's whereabouts.
